problem:
The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=5u-3v-2,\,y=2u+v+7
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}5 & -3 \\ a & b\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}c \\ 7\end{aligned}]
$$

examples.knowledge_point: Finding the Matrix Representation of an Affine Transformation Given its Parametric Form
examples.problem:
The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x = 5u + v - 6, \qquad y = 2u + 4v
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14072116/assets/f017ccc60a7c1bb9ac09978492c9db217836099d0926ee009ffc44ba827c25d5.png)
examples.worked_solution:
An affine transformation $\mathbf T:\mathbb R^2\rightarrow\mathbb R^2$ is a function of the form

$$
\mathbf x = A \mathbf u + \mathbf b,
$$

where $\mathbf x, \mathbf u,$ and $\mathbf b$ are column vectors in $\mathbb R^2,$ and $A$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix.

First, notice that we can express the given transformation as
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14072116/assets/514520062cf4564f58267774ba6b50027f9cd27dedfa392cb7038f94580b1e4a.png)

Separating the constants and expressing the linear part as a product, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5u+v-6 \\ 2u+4v\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5u+v \\ 2u+4v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-6 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}5 & 1 \\ 2 & 4\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{u}+{{[\begin{aligned}-6 \\ 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{b}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c = 1+2+0 = 3.
$$

feedback.problem:
The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=-u+av+b,\,y=2u-5v+c
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 4 \\ 2 & -5\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
An affine transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{2}$ is a function of the form

$$
x=Au+b,
$$

where $x,u,$ and $b$ are column vectors in ${R}^{2},$ and $A$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix.

We can carry out the matrix operations using the matrix form, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =\overset{A}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}-1 & 4 \\ 2 & -5\end{aligned}]}}\cdot \overset{u}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}}+\overset{b}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]}} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-u+4v \\ 2u-5v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-u+4v+2 \\ 2u-5v+1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding elements, we obtain

$$
x=-u+4v+2,\,y=2u-5v+1
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c=4+2+1=7.
$$
